body.text: The microvm workflows resolved `github:nixos/nixpkgs/nixos-unstable` during spindle setup, which calls api.github.com anonymously from the shared runner IP and fails with 403 once that quota is gone; deploy-microvm has not published an image since. Floating via `https://channels.nixos.org/nixos-unstable/nixexprs.tar.xz` keeps unstable without touching GitHub. test-postgres.yml runs on this PR on the same engine, so a green run proves the ref.

title.text: ci: float nixpkgs via the channel tarball to dodge github api rate limits
